battle.name: 帕米拉王國的建立
battle.theater: 敘利亞沙漠與尼羅河三角洲
battle.brief: 公元二七〇年，澤諾比亞在丈夫遇刺後掌控東方，先遣扎布達斯掃蕩哈蘭、攻破博斯拉，再於十月率七萬大軍越過西奈攻入埃及，逐走羅馬將軍特納吉諾・普羅布斯，亞歷山大港易主，一個商隊城市就此建立地跨敘利亞、阿拉伯與埃及的帝國。羅馬標槍是這支部仿羅馬軍團的步兵骨架，卻不是決勝之器。

kit.name: 羅馬標槍
kit.history: 半米長的投槍，槍幹中空。捅穿盾之後就折斷，敵人只能帶著半截槍退回掩體。

countries: 公元二七〇年的東方，實際上有兩套權力並肩而立。羅馬帝國一方，皇位在加里利安努斯、克勞狄烏斯二世、奎因提盧斯與弗洛里阿努斯之間接連更替，敘利亞、巴勒斯坦、阿拉伯與埃及四個行省名義上仍屬皇帝，實權卻分散在各地總督與駐軍手中；駐埃及的羅馬軍團與亞歷山大港的退伍軍人共同構成帝國在尼羅河三角洲的最後骨架，軍中欠餉與搶糧的怨氣正在醞釀變亂。帕米拉一方是一個把商隊城市改造成國家的新型政體：核心是澤諾比亞的家族、城中氏族議會、貝爾神殿的祭司團體，以及掌握商路的商人領袖；她以帕米拉氏族為徵兵基礎組建自己的軍隊，任用塞普蒂米烏斯・扎布達斯與塞普蒂米烏斯・扎拜兩名將領，疆域內的阿拉伯部族時而歸附時而叛離，希蘭與霍蘭的貝都因人主要擔任嚮導、徵糧與商隊護衛。兩套體系之間還夾著一批羅馬公民：敘利亞各城的元老階層、地方議會與羅馬駐軍的大小軍官，他們在帕米拉城中既是人質也是調停者。東方之外還有第三隻手：薩珊王朝隔著幼發拉底河與美索不達米亞看著這場擴張，既盼羅馬被削弱，也不願帕米拉坐大。新皇帝奧勒良在二七〇年一度承認瓦巴拉斯的王號並允許其鑄幣，這種容忍本身就是羅馬對東方新秩序的讓步。
countriesEn: In the east of AD 270 two systems of power in fact stood side by side. On the Roman side the throne changed hands repeatedly through Gallienus, Claudius II, Quintillus and Florianus, and the four provinces of Syria, Palestine, Arabia and Egypt belonged to the emperor in name alone, real authority being dispersed among provincial governors and garrison commanders; the Roman units stationed in Egypt, together with the veterans of Alexandria, formed the last imperial skeleton in the Nile delta, and the arrears of pay and the quarrels over grain were ripening into mutiny. On the Palmyrene side stood a new kind of polity built out of a caravan city: at its core were the family of Zenobia, the tribal council of the city, the priestly college of the Temple of Bel, and the trading magnates who controlled the routes; she raised her army from the tribes of Palmyra, appointed two generals, Septimius Zabdas and Septimius Zabbai, and the Arab tribes inside her borders adhered or revolted as the mood took them, while the Bedouins of Hauran and the Syrian desert served above all as guides, collectors of supplies and escorts of the caravans. Between the two systems sat a body of Roman citizens: the senatorial families of the Syrian cities, the local councils and the Roman officers of every rank, who inside Palmyra were at once hostages and mediators. A third hand watched from beyond the east: the Sasanian court across the Euphrates and Mesopotamia followed this expansion, hoping that Rome would be weakened but unwilling to see Palmyra grow too large. The new emperor Aurelian for a time in AD 270 recognised the royal title of Vaballathus and allowed him to strike coinage, and that toleration was itself a Roman concession to the new order in the east.
people: 澤諾比亞是這場建國的核心人物。她出身帕米拉望族，父家是城中有政治分量的精英，二十多歲便在混亂中接手一個正在崩解的帝國：丈夫奧達伊納圖斯在對波斯的戰事中立下大功，被加里利安努斯於二六〇年封為萬王之王，卻在二六七年被親屬刺殺，十歲上下的瓦巴拉斯被推上王位，她以攝政身分實際掌權。此後她用十年時間把商隊城市的財力改造成軍隊與國庫，用羅馬的頭銜與儀式為新國家加冕：二七〇年她調集大軍進剿哈蘭，十月揮師埃及，二七一年底與兒子並稱奧古斯都。她的下屬中，扎布達斯是全軍主將，攻戰與追擊都由他執行；扎拜負責小亞細亞戰線；羅馬方面的特納吉諾・普羅布斯在十一月一度收復亞歷山大港，隨後敗退至埃及的巴比倫堡，被圍攻俘獲後自盡。皇帝奧勒良是最終的對手，他初期選擇容忍，後期改用兵戎，並在二七二年連勝伊瑪與埃梅薩兩役。帕米拉城內另有一位元老級人物塞普蒂米烏斯・哈杜丹，他在二七三年城破前夕從內部促成開城；反叛首領塞普蒂米烏斯・阿普薩奧斯與被推為奧古斯都的安提奧庫斯，則屬於這場建國的最後一幕。留下記錄的史家包括赫羅狄安、魯斯・佐西莫斯、《奧古斯都史》與埃烏里奧・維克多；近世學者中，費爾古斯・米勒、華威克・鮑爾、安德魯・史密斯與馬克・惠托的解釋，構成本日理解這段史實的主要框架。
peopleEn: Zenobia is the central figure in this foundation of a state. She came from a leading Palmyrene family, her father's house being one of the city's politically influential elite, and she was barely more than twenty when she took over an empire in the process of coming apart: her husband Odaenathus had won great credit in the wars against Persia and was granted the title King of Kings by Gallienus in AD 260, only to be murdered by a relative in AD 267; the nine-year-old Vaballathus was put on the throne and she took power as regent. Over the following ten years she turned the wealth of a caravan city into an army and a treasury, and crowned the new state with Roman titles and Roman ceremonial: in AD 270 she mustered an army to campaign in Hauran, in October she marched into Egypt, and at the end of AD 271 she claimed the title of Augustus alongside her son. Among her subordinates, Zabdas was the commander-in-chief and conducted the attacks and the pursuit; Zabbai handled the front in Asia Minor; on the Roman side, Tenagino Probus briefly retook Alexandria in November, was then beaten back to the fortress of Babylon in Egypt and, after being taken by siege, died by his own hand. The emperor Aurelian was the final opponent, choosing at first toleration and later force of arms, winning the battles of Immae and Emesa in AD 272. Inside Palmyra there was also a man of senatorial rank, Septimius Haddudan, who from within the city brought about its opening in the closing days of AD 273; the rebel leader Septimius Apsaios and Antiochus, who was proclaimed Augustus, belong to the last act of this foundation. The historians who left a record include Herodian, Zosimus, the Historia Augusta and Aurelius Victor; among modern scholars, the interpretations of Fergus Millar, Warwick Ball, Andrew Smith and Mark Whittow form the main frame through which this stretch of history is understood today.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬標槍，在二七〇年的敘利亞與埃及既是真實存在的武器，也已經是被時代改造過的遺物。標槍的形制自共和末期定型：木柄之前套接一段方錐形鐵杆，鐵杆細而長，命中盾牌後會彎折或在接榫處斷裂，敵人只能把一段斷杆從盾上拔下來退回掩體，武器在一次投擲之後就報廢。到二七〇年，羅馬軍團的步兵早已不把這種原始標槍當作主武器：帶盒的舊式標槍早被無套筒的加重標槍取代，晚期軍團士卒轉以長矛與短刺兵器為主，標槍退到輔助軍與輕步兵手中，由專職的標槍手小組投擲。而帕米拉的步兵恰恰沿用這套東方輔助軍的骨架：沙漠與敘利亞各地徵來的步兵持大橢圓盾，以同型加重標槍為主武器，澤諾比亞的家族還按羅馬式樣編制隊伍與旗號，只把軍團鷹徽換成自己的徽記。真正決定帕米拉國運的武器卻不在步兵手上：一方是騎弓與長矛並用的帕米拉騎兵，沙漠騎兵以箭雨機動打亂敵陣，再以整齊的衝鋒矛牆壓上；另一方是羅馬的車載弩砲與配重式投石器，配合攻城塔與撞錘。攻城器械、騎兵與後勤商隊共同決定了這場建國與滅國的走向，標槍只是這支部軍隊的骨架，而不是它的勝負手。
kitsEn: The Roman pilum on this card was, in the Syria and Egypt of AD 270, a weapon that genuinely existed and at the same time a relic already remade by the age. Its shape was settled in the late Republic: a square tapering iron shank socketed onto an ash shaft, the shank thin and long, so that on striking a shield it bent or broke at the joint and the enemy could only pull a broken stump out of the shield and withdraw behind cover, the weapon being spent after a single throw. By AD 270 the legionary infantry of Rome no longer carried such an original pilum as a main arm: the boxed type had long been replaced by the heavier plain-shafted pilum, the late legionary relied increasingly on the spear and on a short thrusting weapon, and the pilum had fallen back into the hands of the auxiliaries and light infantry, thrown by specialist groups. And the Palmyrene infantry followed exactly the skeleton of that eastern auxiliary system: infantry raised in the desert and from the Syrian towns carried large oval shields and used the heavy plain-shafted pilum as their principal missile, and the family of Zenobia still organised its units and standards in Roman fashion, changing only the legionary eagle for a device of its own. The weapons that really decided the fate of the Palmyrene state lay not in the hands of the infantry: on one side the Palmyrene horse, using the bow and the long lance together, showering arrows and manoeuvring to disorder the enemy line before pressing with an ordered wall of lances; on the other the Roman cart-borne bolt-thrower and the stone-thrower, working with siege towers and rams. Siege artillery, cavalry and the baggage train of the caravans together decided the course of this foundation and of its destruction; the pilum was the skeleton of the army, not the hand that settled the match.
tactics: 帕米拉建國的軍事邏輯，是用沙漠的機動去兌換羅馬的行省。第一步是掃清身後：二七〇年春天，澤諾比亞以扎布達斯與扎拜為將，進剿哈蘭一帶的塔努基德部族；扎布達斯攻破博斯拉，殺死羅馬總督，隨後南下控制阿拉伯行省，切斷帝國在東南的邊境稅源。第二步是插入最肥的一塊：十月，七萬大軍自帕米拉出發，越過西奈半島沿地中海東岸直取埃及，戰略意圖很清楚——以埃及的穀物、關稅與亞歷山大港的港口，換取一個與羅馬平起平坐的財政基礎。這支遠征軍是一支混合的沙漠縱隊：騎兵擔任前鋒與偵察，步兵與攻城器械居中，商隊擔任後勤，沿途貝都因人時而為嚮導與徵糧者，時而倒戈。第三步是編制國家：澤諾比亞把家族武裝與帕米拉氏族的徵召兵編為常備軍，以羅馬的軍團、營、護民官等名號命名隊伍，設軍械庫與兵工廠，並以神殿祭司團體與氏族議會分掌民政與稅收。防守上，帕米拉本身就是一座有環形城牆與水源渠道的綠洲要塞，糧草可支應數月；但缺憾同樣明顯——沒有海軍，沒有可與地中海沿岸抗衡的港口，沒有能連續供給大軍作戰的鄉村稅基，首都之外的一切都要靠商隊與徵發維持。到了二七二年奧勒良的攻勢，雙方的戰術差異完全顯影：帕米拉以騎兵與遊騎拖延，羅馬以車載弩砲與投石器在行軍縱隊兩端壓制騎兵，再以圍城塔與壕溝切割守軍；貝都因人最終倒向羅馬，替奧勒良的軍隊供水與糧，而帕米拉城內的元老在最後一刻選擇開城。一支靠標槍步兵、騎弓與商隊組成的軍隊可以打下帝國的埃及，卻守不住一座被包圍又失去水源的城市。
tacticsEn: The military logic behind the founding of Palmyra was to exchange the mobility of the desert for the provinces of Rome. The first step was to clear its own rear: in the spring of AD 270 Zenobia used Zabdas and Zabbai as generals to campaign against the Tanukhids of Hauran; Zabdas sacked Bosra and killed the Roman governor, then moved south to secure the province of Arabia, cutting off the empire's revenue from its south-eastern frontier. The second step was to seize the richest prize: in October an army of seventy thousand left Palmyra, crossed the Sinai and moved down the eastern Mediterranean coast towards Egypt, with a plain strategic intent — to trade the grain, the customs and the harbour of Alexandria for a financial base equal to Rome's own. That expedition was a mixed desert column: cavalry in front as scouts, infantry and siege engines in the centre, the caravans carrying the logistics, with Bedouins acting at times as guides and providers of supplies and at times as turncoats. The third step was the organisation of the state: Zenobia turned the armed men of her family and the levies of the Palmyrene tribes into a standing army, naming its units after Roman models of legions, cohorts and centurions, establishing arsenals and workshops, and leaving civil administration and taxation to the priestly colleges of the temples and to the tribal council. On defence, Palmyra was itself an oasis fortress ringed by a circuit wall and fed by an aqueduct, with grain enough to hold out for months; but the gaps were just as plain — no navy, no harbour able to hold its own against the Mediterranean coast, no village tax base to feed an army in the field, and everything beyond the capital had to be sustained by caravans and requisition. By the time of Aurelian's offensive in AD 272 the contrast in method was fully visible: Palmyra relied on cavalry and raiding to delay, while Rome used the cart-borne bolt-thrower and the stone-thrower at both ends of the marching column to break the horse, and siege towers and ditches to cut the garrison off; in the end the Bedouins turned to Rome and brought water and food to Aurelian's army, while the elders of Palmyra chose at the last moment to open the gates. An army built on pilum-armed infantry, horse archery and caravans could take Egypt away from the empire, but it could not hold a city that was invested and denied its water.
data: 可核對的數字集中在三處。第一處是兵員：史料記載二七〇年十月入埃及的帕米拉軍隊為七萬人，這是帕米拉國度鼎盛時的用兵上限，說明它能一次抽調相當於數個行省的兵力，但這七萬人包含氏族徵召兵、雇傭兵與隨軍商隊在內，並非全部是能上陣的戰兵。第二處是城市規模：二七〇年前後的帕米拉，人口估計在十五萬至二十萬之間，是羅馬治下僅次於羅馬與亞歷山大港的一級城市；亞歷山大港的人口更有五十萬至六十萬，因此拿下它等於拿到帝國最富的稅源與最大的穀物倉之一。帕米拉到亞歷山大港的直線距離約一千四百公里，沿商道與海岸實際要繞行更遠，遠征軍必須自備數十日的飲水與飼料，這正是它必須靠駱駝隊與駱駝商路維持的原因。第三處是財政：公元五七年立在帕米拉的關稅碑，把入城貨物的稅率按品目逐條列明，多數定為四分之一，另加約百分之二列作城市公用的附加；到了二七〇年，這套以商隊為徵稅對象、以神殿與氏族為徵稅機關的制度，被澤諾比亞直接挪用為國家的財政機器。時間上，這個帝國從建國到崩解只有三年：二七〇年建制，二七一年底取得奧古斯都的名號，二七二年被奧勒良逐出敘利亞，二七三年帕米拉被平。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are concentrated in three places. The first is manpower: the sources give the Palmyrene army that entered Egypt in October AD 270 as seventy thousand men, which was the ceiling of what the Palmyrene state could mobilise at once and shows that it could draw on a force equal to several provinces at a time; but that seventy thousand included tribal levies, mercenaries and the men of the caravan train, and not all of them could be counted as fighting men. The second is the size of the cities: around AD 270 the population of Palmyra is estimated at between a hundred and fifty thousand and two hundred thousand, which made it one of the first-rank cities of the Roman world after Rome and Alexandria; Alexandria itself is put at five to six hundred thousand souls, so that taking it meant seizing the richest revenue base and one of the largest grain depots of the empire. The straight line from Palmyra to Alexandria is about fourteen hundred kilometres and the real route by caravan road and along the coast ran considerably further, so an expeditionary army had to carry many weeks of water and fodder with it — which is exactly why it had to lean on camel trains and the camel routes. The third is finance: the tariff inscription set up at Palmyra in AD 57 lists the rate of duty on goods entering the city item by item, mostly at one quarter, with about two percent more set aside for the public benefit of the city; by AD 270 that system, taxing caravans and collecting through temples and tribes, had been appropriated wholesale by Zenobia as the machinery of the state. As to time, the empire lasted only three years from foundation to collapse: constituted in AD 270, it took the title of Augustus at the end of AD 271, was driven out of Syria by Aurelian in AD 272, and Palmyra was levelled in AD 273.
cause: 起因有多層。第一層在帝國的崩解：二六〇年波斯王沙普爾一世在埃德薩重創羅馬，俘虜皇帝瓦勒里安，帝國東部的權威出現真空；加里利安努斯為對付西線的日耳曼壓力，把萬王之王的頭銜授予奧達伊納圖斯，等於用東方的資源換取邊防，帕米拉由此獲得合法的王國地位與廣闊的委任統治區。二六七年奧達伊納圖斯遇刺，十歲上下的瓦巴拉斯繼位，澤諾比亞以攝政掌權；此後加里利安努斯於二六八年暴斃，皇位在一年之內四次易手，意大利在二六九年遭日耳曼人大軍侵入，帝國的軍隊與注意力被吸往西方，東方的真空便一直敞開。第二層是帕米拉自身的商業與地緣優勢：它是地中海與波斯灣、印度之間商路的樞紐，控制關稅、商隊保護與安全通行，本身就是一座可以徵收整條商路稅收的城市；控制埃及就等於握住了羅馬的穀物與關稅，而羅馬恰恰無力保護這些省份免受波斯侵擾。第三層是澤諾比亞個人的抱負與制度設計：她沒有宣布脫離羅馬，而是讓瓦巴拉斯沿用羅馬的稱號、在羅馬皇帝的名義下鑄幣，藉合法君主的外衣擴張實力，直到二七一年底才與兒子並稱奧古斯都，把鬥爭從邊疆的委任統治推到爭奪皇位的高度。史家對此解釋分歧：馬克・惠托認為這是羅馬無力保護帕米拉所激起的反應；華威克・鮑爾認為澤諾比亞瞄準的是羅馬皇位，仿效維斯帕先在敘利亞建立根基的做法；安德魯・史密斯認為獨立與爭位兼而有之；費爾古斯・米勒則強調證據不足，不宜斷言。
causeEn: The causes run in several layers. The first lies in the disintegration of the empire: in AD 260 the Persian king Shapur I struck Rome hard at Edessa and took the emperor Valerian prisoner, and the authority of Rome in the east developed a vacuum; pressed by the Germans in the west, Gallienus bought the eastern frontier with resources by granting the title of King of Kings to Odaenathus, and Palmyra thereby obtained a legal royal position and a wide sphere of delegated rule. Odaenathus was murdered in AD 267, the nine-year-old Vaballathus succeeded him, and Zenobia held power as regent; Gallienus then died violently in AD 268, the throne changed hands four times within a single year, and Italy was overrun by a great German army in AD 269, drawing the legions and the attention of the empire westward and leaving the eastern gap open. The second layer is the commercial and geographical advantage of Palmyra itself: it was the hinge of the caravan routes between the Mediterranean and the Persian Gulf and India, and it controlled the customs, the escorting of caravans and the safe passage of goods, so that it was already a city able to tax an entire trade road; to control Egypt meant to hold Rome's grain and Rome's customs, and Rome was at that moment quite unable to protect those provinces against the Persians. The third layer is Zenobia's own ambition and the design of her institutions: she did not proclaim a break from Rome but let Vaballathus keep Roman titles and struck coin in the name of the Roman emperor, expanding real power under the cloak of a legitimate ruler, and only at the end of AD 271 did she and her son take the title of Augustus together, lifting the contest from the delegated rule of a frontier into the struggle for the imperial throne itself. Historians disagree about the reading of this. Mark Whittow took it as a reaction to the failure of Rome to protect Palmyra; Warwick Ball held that Zenobia was aiming at the Roman throne, imitating the way Vespasian built a power base in Syria; Andrew Smith saw independence and the bid for the throne as combined aims; and Fergus Millar stressed that the evidence is insufficient for a firm conclusion.
impact: 影響分為帝國與帕米拉兩面。在帝國一面，這三年證明了一件令所有皇帝不安的事：行省裡的城市，只要掌握商路、稅源與羅馬式的軍制，就足以在一夜之間擁有帝國三分之一的土地與人口，而羅馬竟無力阻止。帕米拉的存亡也直接改變了財政與軍事的地理：埃及的穀物與關稅流向何方、敘利亞的兵源歸誰調度、阿拉伯邊境由誰巡邏，都一度由一個商隊城市決定；直到奧勒良把它打回原形，帝國才重新獲得東方的收入與招募基地。在帕米拉一面，三年的皇帝生涯幾乎耗盡了這座城市的制度儲備：氏族議會、祭司團體、商會與神廟財政在戰爭中被榨到極限，軍械庫與兵工廠被羅馬沒收，圍城期的徵發與物資耗盡，加上隨後的拆毀，使這座城市作為商路樞紐的地位難以恢復，直到戴克里先時代才以小型駐軍城鎮的形式在廢墟上重建。澤諾比亞被帶到羅馬後，她的後代在帝國貴族中延續，帕米拉也由一個帝國變成一段記憶：在中世紀拉丁語世界裏，澤諾比亞是被俘的東方女皇的原型，近代以來又成為敘利亞民族主義所推崇的唯一的敘利亞帝國；帕米拉城的三座紀念性拱門雖早於澤諾比亞，卻已是這座城市從商隊聚落走向帝國首都的預告。
impactEn: The effects fall on two sides, Rome and Palmyra. On the Roman side these three years demonstrated something that unsettled every emperor: a city of the provinces, holding the caravan roads, the taxes and a Roman-style military system, could in a single night own a third of the empire's land and people while Rome was unable to stop it. The continued existence of Palmyra also directly rearranged the financial and military geography: where the grain and customs of Egypt went, who drew the recruits of Syria, who patrolled the Arabian frontier — all of these were for a time decided by a caravan city; only after Aurelian beat it back into its old shape did the empire recover the revenue and the recruiting base of the east. On the Palmyrene side, three years of emperorship drained the institutional reserves of the city: the tribal council, the priestly colleges, the merchants and the temple finances were squeezed to the limit, the arsenals and workshops were confiscated by Rome, and the requisitions and shortages of the siege, followed by the demolition, left the city unable to recover its place as the hinge of the caravan roads, and it was rebuilt on the ruins only in the reign of Diocletian, as a small garrison town. After Zenobia was carried to Rome her descendants continued in the aristocracy of the empire, and Palmyra passed from being an empire to being a memory: in the medieval Latin world Zenobia was the archetype of the captive queen of the east, and in modern times she has been claimed as the only truly Syrian empire by Syrian nationalism; the three monumental arches of Palmyra, though older than Zenobia, were already the promise of a caravan settlement turning into an imperial capital.
result: 結果分三段。第一段是建國本身：二七〇年春天澤諾比亞平定哈蘭，十月扎布達斯引七萬大軍入埃及，十一月亞歷山大港一度被羅馬將軍特納吉諾・普羅布斯收回，但他隨即敗於巴比倫堡之圍而自盡，埃及全境歸入帕米拉；帕米拉王國就此握有敘利亞、巴勒斯坦、阿拉伯、埃及與小亞細亞的大部，人口與稅基都超越帝國任何一個行省，國號、儀式與鑄幣體系在二七〇年至二七一年間逐步成形，瓦巴拉斯與澤諾比亞並稱奧古斯都。第二段是崩解：二七二年奧勒良自小亞細亞攻入，在伊瑪擊敗澤諾比亞，在埃梅薩再戰一場，隨後深入沙漠圍困帕米拉；貝都因人倒向羅馬，澤諾比亞出城求援波斯而被擄，城中元老於二七二年底促成開城，羅軍只留六百名弓手駐守。二七三年城內又起反叛，推塞普蒂米烏斯・阿普薩奧斯為首並擁立安提奧庫斯，奧勒良再率大軍平叛，保留安提奧庫斯的性命，卻把帕米拉夷平，把最珍貴的建築與藝術品運回羅馬裝飾他的太陽神神廟，並洗劫城中最神聖的神殿。最後是總評：這場建國在軍事上極為成功，在制度上極為脆弱——它證明沙漠商路可以養出一支帝國軍隊，也證明一個沒有海軍、沒有鄉村稅基、沒有帝國式徵兵體系的國家，一旦被皇帝本人帶著攻城器械與野戰大軍正面盯上，就撐不過一次圍城。
resultEn: The outcome came in three stages. The first was the foundation itself: in the spring of AD 270 Zenobia pacified Hauran, in October Zabdas led seventy thousand men into Egypt, in November Alexandria was for a moment recovered by the Roman general Tenagino Probus, who was then broken at the siege of Babylon and died by his own hand, and the whole of Egypt passed to Palmyra; the Palmyrene kingdom now held most of Syria, Palestine, Arabia, Egypt and Asia Minor, with a population and a revenue greater than any single province of the empire, while the state name, the ceremonial and the coinage took shape between AD 270 and AD 271, and Vaballathus and Zenobia claimed the title of Augustus together. The second stage was the collapse: in AD 272 Aurelian came in through Asia Minor, defeated Zenobia at Immae and again at Emesa, and then pushed into the desert to invest Palmyra; the Bedouins turned to Rome, Zenobia left the city to seek Persian help and was taken prisoner, the elders of the city brought about its surrender before the end of AD 272, and the Romans left behind only six hundred archers as a garrison. In AD 273 the city rose again under Septimius Apsaios, who was followed by the proclamation of Antiochus, and Aurelian marched against it once more, sparing Antiochus' life but razing Palmyra, carrying its most valuable buildings and artworks back to Rome to adorn his Temple of Sol and plundering the city's holiest sanctuary. The final reckoning is this: the foundation was a great military success and a fragile structure. It showed that the desert caravan roads could feed an imperial army, and equally that a state with no navy, no village tax base and no Roman system of recruitment could not survive a single siege once the emperor himself brought up the engines and the field army to face it.
